ai_positioning.summary: LPG adopte une posture défensive vis-à-vis de l'IA, mentionnant principalement les risques liés aux incidents de cybersécurité et aux mauvaises applications de l'IA dans ses opérations, sans indiquer de développement ou d'intégration stratégique de solutions IA.

company_description: Dorian LPG Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the transportation of liquefied petroleum gas through its LPG tankers worldwide. The company owns and operates twenty-five very large gas carriers. Dorian LPG Ltd. was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut.
